headline: NVIDIA Board probes CEO's link to suspected spy
dek: This follows reports that CEO Jensen Huang was targeted by a Chinese spy operation[S1].
what_happened: Nvidia’s board launched an independent investigation into CEO Jensen Huang’s relationship with a suspected Chinese spy,[S1][S3].
Apple is accelerating Siri’s development to match rival AI agents, with third-party app integration expected in the Spring[S4].
Google Health users can now hide the AI Coach via privacy controls without losing other Premium features[S5].

sections.title: NVIDIA Board probes ceo's link to suspected spy
paragraphs: This follows reports that CEO Jensen Huang was targeted by a Chinese spy operation[S1]. The announcement came after a memo from Huang circulated among employees[S1]. He admitted to an affair with Alice Huang, a former executive at Megaspeed[S1]. The board said Huang fully supports the review and has committed to cooperating with it[S1].

A memo circulating among U.S. policymakers earlier this year claimed Alice Huang was recruited by China’s Ministry of State Security[S1]. The goal was to spy on Nvidia’s CEO[S1]. In his memo, Huang apologized to his family and colleagues for his actions[S1]. The board emphasized that it prioritizes U.S. national and economic security above all else[S1].

Chips, especially Nvidia’s, have been a major focus as the AI race between the United States and China heats up[S1]. This context highlights the strategic importance of Nvidia in the current geopolitical landscape[S1].

sections.title: Apple plans to make Siri more agentic
paragraphs: Apple is working to make Siri more agentic, according to Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman[S4]. CEO John Ternus is pressuring AI leader Craig Federighi to speed up the roadmap[S4]. The goal is to deliver a powerful AI agent that can compete with OpenAI’s Dots or Meta’s Muse[S4].

First, Siri will gain fine-grained control over Apple’s first-party apps[S4]. This allows actions like rotating images in Photos or organizing Safari tabs[S4]. These features are expected in iOS 27.3[S4]. Second, Siri will integrate with third-party apps[S4]. This could let users place orders via Grubhub or book tables on OpenTable[S4]. Gurman says this larger change is likely to land in the Spring[S4].
Apple wants Siri to pursue objectives independently[S4].

sections.title: Google Health lets users hide its AI Coach
paragraphs: Google released an update in August 2026 that allows users to disable the AI Coach feature[S5]. This change applies to the Google Health app for subscribers[S5].

They then select Your data in Google Health[S5]. Next, they scroll to Feature privacy controls and select Manage[S5]. Users can also access this via Google Health settings and Coaching[S5]. Another option is changing Coach messages on Today to No Coach insights[S5]. Users lose access to the Ask Coach button for questions[S5].
To do so, they tap the Ask Coach button[S5]. They then select Unlock Coach to restore the feature[S5]. These include advanced sleep tracking and Health Guardian[S5].
